components.name: Six-dot Path (small)

narrative.overview:
One stylesheet, tokens first. The ground is blue-black (ground), surfaces are slate a step lighter, text is cool off-white in three strengths, and one blue does all the pointing. Inter is the only face and it is bundled; the page makes no request outside its own origin. Light mode is the same tokens re-valued, not a second design.

Two surfaces share the system and differ in posture. The workshop (older: .card, .kcol, .cal, .matrix, .block) is an operator's board: bordered slate cards on a tonal grid, small uppercase tracked labels, status tones (ok / warn / bad) on bars, badges and dots. The desk (newest: .desk, .shelf, .pc, .path, .journey, .prose) is a creator's start page: pieces are generated covers laid on the bare ground without card chrome, state is a sentence in plain words, a six-dot path shows the way, and one filled button per piece says what is next. Where they differ, the desk is the newer intent; the workshop is kept as it is.
keyCharacteristics: Dark primary, slate layering, almost no shadows except under covers.
One sans (Inter variable), weights from 400 body to 800 brand.
Blue accent reserved for the one action, the current step and focus.
On the desk, the covers bring the colour; everything else is ink on slate.
Secondary actions are quiet text, never a second filled button.

rules.name: The Covers Carry the Colour Rule
rules.body: On the desk, no element except the cover and the one accent button is coloured. Status tones stay in the workshop and in the piece page's notes.

rules.name: The One Button Rule
rules.body: A piece shows exactly one filled accent button: on its card and at its current step. Everything else it can do is quiet text (.quiet) or a ghost button.

rules.name: The One Sans Rule
rules.body: Inter for everything that is read. Mono only for things a machine named: file names, keys, the label code on a cover.

rules.name: The Sentence Not Badge Rule
rules.body: On the desk a piece's state is a sentence in ink-quiet, never a pill. Badges remain on the piece page for note status and helper runs.

rules.name: The Flat Slate, Lifted Cover Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat and bordered. Only covers (and the login card) cast shadow, and a cover's shadow is the same in light mode: it is an object, not a surface.

dos: Do put the one action in a filled accent pill and every other action in quiet text or a ghost pill.
Do let covers be the colour: generated SVG posters with shadow, placed on the bare ground.
Do say state as a sentence in ink-quiet on the desk; keep ok/warn/bad for the workshop and the notes thread.
Do keep the six dots identical on card and page; only size and labels change.
Do use the three radii (8 / 12 / pill) for panels and controls; covers keep their own.
Do derive light mode by re-valuing the six neutral tokens only.
Do keep every file of a piece reachable from its page (tiles, matrix, record).
donts: Don't name a stage, label or file on the desk; the reader translates through vocabulary.json.
Don't add a second filled button to a piece.
Don't box a piece card on the desk; the workshop card is the older pattern.
Don't add a second typeface or load anything from outside the origin.
Don't put shadows on panels; shadow belongs to covers.
Don't colour the desk card by state; the dots and the sentence carry it.
